summary:
Complete implementation plan for Kaya (LifeChart) — a patient-friendly lifelong health timeline web app for India's ABDM/ABHA ecosystem. Covers:

- Full architecture: React + Vite + Tailwind frontend, Supabase backend
- 88-file project structure with feature-based organization
- 10 PostgreSQL tables with Row Level Security policies
- 10 pages: Landing, Login, Dashboard, Timeline, Upload/OCR, Doctor Summary, Share/Consent, Family, Emergency Card, Reminders
- Realistic Indian mock data spanning 15+ years
- Hindi/English internationalization
- Medical-grade design system (teal + white, 18px base, elderly-friendly)
- OCR strategy for digitizing old prescriptions
- Mock ABDM integration with clearly marked hooks for real APIs
- Build execution order (18 steps)
- Open questions about voice input, notifications, deployment, and branding
